title: Bottle Bench · Choose the print plan
brief: Turn a six-bottle craft rack into an editable, inspectable slicing project. Compare draft, everyday and fine layers using the same mesh, printer, material and orientation.
assumptions: Software-only example: Prusa MK3S, one 0.4 mm nozzle, PLA, High Temp Plate. These are not facts about your printer. The 26.6 mm bottle pockets and 2.4 mm floor have not been physically fit-tested; dry indoor craft storage only.

plans.label: Draft
plans.description: Coarser layers and two walls. Compare a faster dimensional trial; this is not a strength recommendation.

plans.label: Everyday
plans.description: A middle comparison with three walls and 0.20 mm layers. Inspect the first layer and pocket paths.

plans.label: Fine layers
plans.description: 0.16 mm layers, same walls and infill as Everyday. Compare surface resolution against time and material—not a guaranteed finish.
